connectors.name: 微盛企微管家SCRM
connectors.description: Weisheng SCRM integration for WeCom customer management and private domain operations.
connectors.description_zh: 查询或管理企业微信中的客户信息、客户标签、客户群、营销素材、活码、群发、跟进记录、联系人、商机、汇报、抽奖、客户日程、聊天记录等业务能力。
connectors.description_en: Query or manage WeCom (WeChat Work) business capabilities: customer info, tags, groups, marketing assets, QR codes, campaigns, follow-ups, contacts, opportunities, reports, lucky draws, schedules, chat records and more.
examples_zh: 帮我查询一下我上周新增了几个客户
创建我的员工活码，欢迎语设置为：您好👋，很高兴为您服务！有任何需求随时和我说～
我下午要去拜访张三这个客户，请整理他的客户画像信息，帮我准备一下
帮我给最新添加的客户，根据沟通内容和需求，生成几个跟进任务给对应员工，包含跟进目标、话术
帮我创建一个今天下午两点的日程，提醒我跟进最近添加的客户，内容是主动向客户介绍新功能
examples_en: How many new customers did I get last week?
Create my staff QR code with welcome message: Hello 👋, glad to serve you! Feel free to reach out anytime~
I'm visiting customer Zhang San this afternoon. Please pull up their profile and help me prepare.
Generate follow-up tasks for recently added customers based on their chat content and needs, including goals and talking points
Create a schedule at 2 PM today to remind me to follow up with recently added customers and introduce new features
